summary: Applied all three triaged spec review fixes: gate scope, permission audit contract, and sentinel scan scope.

items.title: Gate scope is ambiguous between task and integration gate-impl
items.rationale: The spec now limits artifact trust validation to flow-level gate-impl (phase=integration) and explicitly excludes task-level gate-impl (phase=task-impl) from requiring test-execute-result.json and test-result-review.json.
items.evidence: spec.json goal, scope.in[0..1], scope.out[0], requirements R1/R2/R4, acceptance_criteria[0..5], overview decisions, and T-2 now name flow-level gate-impl (phase=integration).

items.title: User-permission audit record has no deterministic contract
items.rationale: The spec now defines specs/<spec>/placeholder-permission.json as the deterministic audit record and lists required fields and relation to placeholder artifact paths.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[2], requirements[4].desc, acceptance_criteria[5], clarifications[2].a, and overview.decisions define version, phase, approvedByUser, artifactPaths, permissionText, reason, and createdAt.

items.title: Placeholder sentinel scan scope is undefined
items.rationale: The spec now enumerates the exact JSON paths subject to sentinel rejection and states that file-map path values and raw log text are not globally sentinel-scanned.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[2].desc, acceptance_criteria[5..6], clarifications[1].a, and overview.decisions define the scan set and exclusions.
